chunks: Musa ibn al-Qasim from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hammad from al-Halabi from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
"Your sacrificial animals should be fat, for indeed Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) preferred that his sacrifice be fat."
ai.seo_question: What is the recommended quality of the sacrificial animal in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* highlights the Sunnah of selecting high-quality, well-nourished animals for sacrifice, reflecting the Imam’s emphasis on generosity and excellence (ihsan) in worship. By citing Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq’s personal practice, it underscores the Shia tradition of emulating the Imams’ meticulousness in ritual acts, linking physical quality to spiritual sincerity.
